description: Realtime conversational model with text and audio responses, tool calling, web search and voice cloning.
notes: Alibaba’s own model availability table dates the Flash release October 27 and specifies 262144 tokens. Native speech docs additionally limit retained audio to 50 turns or 300 seconds.
